subject: german
promptStrong: Give me an exam-style {board} {level} {subject} question on {lo}, then mark my answer against the mark scheme.
promptWeak: Explain {lo} for {board} {level} {subject} simply, with a clear example and the most common mistake students make.

questions.q: How do you say 'On my birthday we eat cake'?
options: An meinem Geburtstag backen wir kein Brot
An meinem Geburtstag essen wir Kuchen
An meinem Geburtstag essen wir Suppe
questions.explain: 'Der Geburtstag' = 'birthday' and 'der Kuchen' = 'cake'.

questions.q: What does 'im Ausland' mean?
questions.explain: 'Im Ausland' means 'abroad'. 'Das Ausland' = foreign countries; 'das Inland' = home country.

questions.q: What does 'Der Zug hat Verspätung' mean?
questions.explain: 'Verspätung haben' means 'to be delayed/late', so 'Der Zug hat Verspätung' = 'The train is delayed'.

questions.q: Which sentence means 'There is a lot of pollution'?
questions.explain: 'Es gibt viel' = 'there is a lot of' and 'Umweltverschmutzung' = 'pollution', so this is correct.

questions.q: What does 'der Treibhauseffekt' mean?
questions.explain: 'Der Treibhauseffekt' means 'the greenhouse effect'.

questions.q: What does 'Wir sollten mehr recyceln' mean?
questions.explain: 'Wir sollten' is the conditional of 'sollen' = 'we should'; 'mehr' = 'more'.

questions.q: What does 'das Rauchen' mean?
questions.explain: 'Das Rauchen' means 'smoking' (the activity). 'Der Raum' (room) is a near-miss distractor.

questions.q: What does 'das Feuerwerk' mean?
questions.explain: 'Das Feuerwerk' means 'the fireworks (display)'.

questions.q: How do you say 'We celebrate Easter with the family'?
options: Wir feiern Weihnachten mit der Familie
Wir feiern Ostern mit der Familie
Wir feiern Ostern ohne die Familie
questions.explain: 'Feiern' = 'to celebrate', 'Ostern' = 'Easter', 'mit der Familie' = 'with the family'.

questions.q: What does 'verreisen' mean?
questions.explain: 'Verreisen' means 'to go away/travel (somewhere)'.

questions.q: Which sentence means 'I follow many influencers online'?
questions.explain: 'Folgen' takes the dative, so 'Ich folge vielen Influencern online' (present tense) = 'I follow many influencers online'.

questions.q: What does 'das Oktoberfest' refer to?
options: A wine festival on the Rhine
A famous beer and folk festival in Munich
questions.explain: 'Das Oktoberfest' is the famous beer and funfair festival held in Munich.

questions.q: What does 'Ich bekomme ein Geschenk' mean?
questions.explain: False friend: 'bekommen' means 'to get/receive', not 'to become'. 'To become' is 'werden'.

questions.q: What does 'Geschenke schenken' mean?
questions.explain: 'Schenken' means 'to give (as a gift)', so 'Geschenke schenken' = 'to give presents'.

questions.q: What does 'die Klimaerwärmung' mean?
questions.explain: 'Die Klimaerwärmung' (also 'die globale Erwärmung') means 'global warming'.

questions.q: How do you say 'We spent the holidays by the sea'?
options: Wir verbringen die Ferien am Meer
Wir haben die Ferien am Meer gebraucht
Wir haben die Ferien am Meer verbracht
Wir haben die Ferien in den Bergen verbracht
questions.explain: 'Am Meer' = 'by the sea' and 'verbracht' (perfect of 'verbringen') = 'spent'; 'gebraucht' (needed) is the trap.

questions.q: What does 'sich verkleiden' mean at carnival?
questions.explain: 'Sich verkleiden' means 'to dress up in costume/fancy dress', common at carnival.

questions.q: What does 'der Klimawandel' mean?
questions.explain: 'Der Klimawandel' means 'climate change' (Klima + Wandel = change).

questions.q: What does 'der Faschingsdienstag' mean?
questions.explain: 'Der Faschingsdienstag' is Shrove Tuesday, the peak day of carnival before Lent.

questions.q: How do you say 'We are flying to Spain'?
questions.explain: 'Fliegen nach' = 'to fly to' and 'Spanien' = Spain.

questions.q: What does 'sich sonnen' mean?
questions.explain: 'Sich sonnen' means 'to sunbathe' (from 'die Sonne' = sun).

questions.q: Which sentence means 'We should save energy'?
questions.explain: 'Sparen' = 'to save' and 'verschwenden' = 'to waste'; 'Wir sollten Energie sparen' = 'We should save energy'.
